title: The Channels site reads the live SKYLARK-MANAGER channel through the argv-only agentipc client (read-only, no announcer writes)

watcher.instructions: You are cviewer, a Channels viewer. Open the channel overview and read the live SKYLARK-MANAGER channel through the site. The view is read-only.

anon.instructions: You are not signed in. Try to read the live SKYLARK-MANAGER channel and expect a refusal.

steps.describe: the channel overview lists the node's channels
a live channel renders through the argv-only client
an anonymous channel read is refused (role negative)
